versions.changelog:
Initial release – tech-roadmap-generator 1.0.0

- Automatically generates high-quality SVG/PNG academic technology roadmaps based on 10 classic templates.
- Supports input of research topics or uploading text for intelligent content parsing and route filling.
- Offers template auto-selection based on research type, or lets users specify a template.
- Provides output preview and high-resolution PNG export.
- Designed for academic research, project proposals, and research design visualization.
